meta.rationale: The Amiga's bright blue screen, a title bar across the top, drawers you double-click, and the famous bouncing ball.
meta.theme-about: Amiga Workbench 1.3: a flat bright blue screen with a white-and-blue screen title bar across the top showing free memory, the apps as small chunky drawer and disk icons in a loose grid at the top-left, the red-and-white checkered Boing ball bouncing in a canvas at the right, orange-accented windows with depth gadgets. 1987 home computer, cheerful. (#screenbar, #drawers, #boing)

desktop.canvas: function draw(w, h, t) for i = 0, 10 do g.line(i * w / 10, h * 0.35, i * w / 10, h, "rgba(170,0,170,0.6)", 1) end for j = 0, 6 do g.line(0, h * 0.35 + j * h * 0.65 / 6, w, h * 0.35 + j * h * 0.65 / 6, "rgba(170,0,170,0.6)", 1) end local r = 64 local x = r + (math.abs(((t * 70) % (2 * (w - 2 * r))) - (w - 2 * r))) local y = h - r - 10 - math.abs(math.sin(t * 2.4)) * (h * 0.55) g.circle(x + 18, h - 14, r * 0.9, "rgba(0,0,0,0.25)") g.circle(x, y, r, "#ffffff") local spin = t * 3 for a = 0, 7 do for b = 0, 3 do if (a + b) % 2 == 0 then local a0 = a / 8 * math.pi * 2 + spin local lat0, lat1 = -1 + b / 2, -1 + (b + 1) / 2 local pts = {} for k = 0, 4 do local ang = a0 + k / 4 * (math.pi / 4) local c = math.cos(ang) if c > -0.05 then local yy = lat0 + (lat1 - lat0) * 0 pts[#pts + 1] = x + math.sin(ang) * r * math.sqrt(1 - lat0 * lat0) pts[#pts + 1] = y + lat0 * r end end for k = 4, 0, -1 do local ang = a0 + k / 4 * (math.pi / 4) if math.cos(ang) > -0.05 then pts[#pts + 1] = x + math.sin(ang) * r * math.sqrt(1 - lat1 * lat1) pts[#pts + 1] = y + lat1 * r end end if #pts >= 6 then g.poly(pts, "#dd1111") end end end end end
